items.title: George Wein — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to see Texaco Star Theater with Milton Berle, Television, Jello Again – This is Jack Benny instead of Hello Again.

ctx.x: The whole corporate sponsorship world, I would imagine, has a certain language, a certain process. I mean, where did you pick up on this? How did you finesse these situations?
Oh, very easy. I used to see Texaco Star Theater with Milton Berle, Television, Jello Again – This is Jack Benny instead of Hello Again. I mean, hey, sponsors support everything.
This is American capitalist system, you know what I mean? If you can get some of that to keep yourself alive, get it as long as it didn't mess with your show.
